episodes.title: Amsterdam Centraal
episodes.summary: Police officers Mardik and Shannon are called at night for a bomb threat at Amsterdam Central Station. The next day, Mardik has to report to the office for an investigation by AIVD detective Joëlle. Does he still have contact with people from the past?

episodes.title: Schokkende meldingen
episodes.summary: The AIVD investigation influences the choices of Mardik and his family, which only sharpens the AIVD investigation. A shocking report arrives at the control room of the Amsterdam police about a bus on a market square. When Mardik suspects his old childhood friend Faysal's involvement, Shannon joins the investigation.

episodes.title: Op de vlucht
episodes.summary: Michelle helps her husband Mardik flee and leaves for her parental home with their daughter Pip. Would janitor Malik Fardin know where Mardik can find his old friend Faysal? Meanwhile, the emergency services on the market form an organized chaos, but is it safe there?

episodes.title: Bruut geweld
episodes.summary: A shopping mall is held hostage by the terror of Faysal's men. Mardik, still on the run from his own colleagues, goes in search of Reza with the help of Malik Fardin to get in touch with Faysal. A wedding party is violently disrupted. Linda is put to the test in the control room when a loved one is revealed to be among the hostages.

episodes.title: Kat en muis
episodes.summary: The mall is still in the grip of Faysal's terrorists. Shoppers and shopkeepers scramble to escape. Michelle is questioned so intensely by Ilja that Joelle has no choice but to intervene. Mardik pushes Reza to his limits. Everything to get in touch with Faysal.

episodes.title: De grote klap
episodes.summary: Terrorist Faysal literally has his old childhood friend police officer Mardik in his sights. While the truth is slowly emerging more and more, Ilja has set his sights on Mardik. How will this gigantic confrontation and finale end?

episodes.title: Val of vecht
episodes.summary: After preventing a major attack in the Netherlands in the first season, Mardik discovers that a much larger conspiracy has been set in motion.

episodes.title: Uur nul
episodes.summary: An international conference in Amsterdam descends into chaos and violence, followed by a violent hostage situation, when heavily armed men storm the building. Hundreds of visitors are locked in, the demands are harsh and personal. Nigel leads the operation, but loses control. Joëlle chooses a dangerous route, while Mardik becomes the explicit target of the hostage-takers. He realizes that the hostage situation is not just an incident—it is the beginning of a plan that turns out to be much bigger and deadlier than expected.

episodes.title: Stick to the plan
episodes.summary: The hostage situation takes a terrible turn, which deeply affects Joëlle. Nigel negotiates, but gets stuck. Driven by anger and revenge, Joëlle discovers that someone from the police is involved in the plot. She tries to get in touch with him. Max is in danger of falling into the wrong hands. Mardik tries to stay out of the hands of his pursuers and wants to contact Michelle and Pip. The plan of the perpetrators of the hostage-taking becomes increasingly clear and increasingly deadly.

episodes.title: Europa in brand
episodes.summary: After the hostage-taking, the city turns into a powder keg. Riots, reprisals, and fear sweep across the Netherlands. While the streets explode and Joëlle follows clues to Brussels, Mardik realizes that the terrorists now have his family directly in their sights. In Brussels, Frederique discovers that the danger is greater than any one country can handle and that the threat does not stop at the Netherlands, but has penetrated deep into European institutions. The violence in the streets turns out to be part of a network that wants to disrupt Europe.

episodes.title: Als het vuur gedoofd is
episodes.summary: On the surface, calm returns, but behind the scenes, chaos reigns supreme. Mardik discovers that Michelle and Pip are being held hostage and that Tigre is using them as leverage. To get closer to the terrorists, he ventures into a risky infiltration. Meanwhile, Joëlle and Frederique encounter a crucial link within Eurapol, where power and betrayal converge. Max becomes more deeply entangled in Gideon's grip, who mercilessly exploits his weaknesses. What appears to be safe turns out to be the preparation for a new attack. Tigre seems to hold all the cards when Mardik discovers a terrible truth.

episodes.title: The beginning
episodes.summary: In Croatia, Tigre finally shows his darkest side. Mardik is in danger of losing what he holds most dear when Tigre manipulates and pressures him with Michelle and Pip. He has nowhere to turn when Tigre forces him to do the unthinkable. A ruthless attack in Brussels looms, and Mardik and Joëlle must do what they can—while saving Michelle and Pip. Max seems to have switched to the ‘dark side', but nothing is what it seems. The clock is ticking as the meeting in Brussels begins and even Michelle and Pip have been brought to the scene of the attack by Tigre. What seems like the end turns out to be only the beginning.
